note: Third-party embed vendors (P2-017). `containers` are compound CSS selectors (tag, .class, #id, [attr], [attr=v], [attr^=v], [attr$=v], [attr*=v]; no combinators) that identify an embed container: an iframe or the blockquote/div a vendor script fills. Findings on elements strictly inside a container are tagged third_party with the vendor; findings on the container itself (an iframe missing a title, its placement) stay the site's own. `element_markers` tag elements a vendor injects anywhere by their own attributes, id/class token prefix or asset URLs (GrowSurf). Override the file with WCAG_THIRD_PARTY_CONFIG=<path>.
